review_notes: I read the whole 63-line file and checked it against the rubric. The only nontrivial reasoning is that the range of `weights` is convex. The private lemma `convex_range_weights` already factors that out, and both instances use it. What remains duplicated is short: each instance takes the convex-range instance and transports it along `(isEmbedding_toFun_comp_weights ℝ ι).toHomeomorph`. One instance uses the homeomorphism directly (contractible) and the other uses its symm (locally path connected). These are one-line wrappers around existing API, so a shared lemma would not be an improvement. I did not search the source roots for similar proofs elsewhere, since nothing in this file calls for a new helper.
